name: Slack
description: Send and receive messages, and get notified about activity directly in Slack.
note: Requires a Slack workspace admin to approve.

name: Microsoft Teams
description: Bring conversations, calls, and notifications into your Teams channels.

name: Keka
description: Sync employee records and attendance data with your Keka HR account.

name: Twilio
description: Send SMS and voice notifications using your own Twilio number.
note: You'll need a Twilio Account SID and Auth Token.

name: ChatGPT
description: Use OpenAI models to draft replies and summarize conversations.
note: Bring your own OpenAI API key.

name: Pinpoint
description: Pull candidate and job pipeline data from Pinpoint ATS.

name: AWS
description: Store attachments and backups in your own S3 bucket.
note: Requires an IAM role with S3 write access.
